text:
Nora Li: Quick copy review — we have a new toast that shows when a model request times out. Current toast: "Model request timed out. Try again." Feels unhelpful. Screenshot: https://redwood.screenshot/timeout-toast.png
Omar: Agreed. We should give guidance (retry, lower max tokens, or switch model) and keep it skimmable. Toast space is small though.
Bea: Also make sure the toast action label is explicit for a11y (screen readers read button text). Avoid vague labels like "Retry" alone if possible.
Nora Li: Constraints: toast is single line with one inline action. We can use short sentence fragments. Primary action currently triggers a retry. Secondary action not available in toast (we have a details link in the logs panel).
Ken (eng): Important: backend returns a specific code for timeout vs server error. We can surface slight variant copy if we detect a timeout vs overloaded node. For timeout we can suggest "Try again or reduce max tokens". For overload we should suggest "Try again later". Also keep strings localizable.
CopyBot: Microcopy checklist: 1) one-line toast <=80 chars, 2) primary action <=3 words, 3) prefer imperative verbs, 4) provide a short hint when helpful, 5) avoid punctuation at end of fragments.
Omar: Draft short variants for timeout toast (one-liners):
- "Request timed out 1 Retry or reduce max tokens"
- "Inference timed out 1 Retry with fewer tokens"
- "Model response timed out 1 Retry or switch model"

Bea: For action label suggestions (keep 2-3 words):
- "Retry request"
- "Retry with fewer tokens" (might be long)
- "Retry" (short but vague)

Nora Li: I like "Inference timed out 1 Retry request" with action "Retry request". But check length. Also we should avoid contractions in code strings.
Ken (eng): I'll measure typical toast char width. If "Retry request" fits, we can use it. Alternate fallback: headline only "Inference timed out" with action "Retry" and the logs can show the tip to reduce tokens.
Bea: For accessibility make the action label read as a complete instruction: "Retry request" is fine. Also include aria-describedby linking to logs panel when users want details.
Omar: Suggest a slightly friendlier tone: "Inference timed out 1 Try again or reduce tokens" (action: "Retry request"). Friendly but still concise.
Nora Li: Final proposed strings for the toast and code (no contractions):
```
Toast: "Inference timed out - Try again or reduce tokens"
Action label: "Retry request"
Alternate (short): "Inference timed out"
Action label (short): "Retry"
```
Ken (eng): I'll run UI fit tests and wire the two variants based on available space. If the longer toast truncates poorly we'll fall back to the short variant. I'll also surface a small link in logs to "How to reduce tokens".
CopyBot: Localization note: separate the hint ("Try again or reduce tokens") so translators can reorder if needed. Avoid embedded commands in a single string.
Nora Li: Great — I'll update the mock and push to Figma with both variants. Will add a note for i18n team. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
